sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已上线，您可以在任何收听播客的平台上收听。

sentences.en: It was Wednesday the 2nd of August, 1989.
sentences.zh: 那是1989年8月2日，星期三。

sentences.en: 41-year-old Marguerite Edwards started the day like any other,
sentences.zh: 41岁的玛格丽特·爱德华兹像往常一样开始了新的一天，

sentences.en: making sure her three daughters were up and ready for school.
sentences.zh: 确保她的三个女儿起床并准备好去上学。

sentences.en: Marguerite was happily married to Ian Edwards, a successful orthodontist with a surgery in Bondi.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特与伊恩·爱德华兹婚姻幸福，伊恩是一位成功的正畸医生，在邦迪经营着一家诊所。

sentences.en: They lived in a two-storey house on Victoria Road, Wallara, in Sydney's eastern suburbs.
sentences.zh: 他们住在悉尼东郊瓦拉拉维多利亚路上的一栋两层小楼里。

sentences.en: Wallara is an extremely affluent suburb, 5km east of Sydney's CBD, a few miles.
sentences.zh: 瓦拉拉是一个极其富裕的郊区，位于悉尼中央商务区以东约5公里处。

sentences.en: Known for its quiet, tree-lined streets and extremely expensive housing.
sentences.zh: 这里以安静、绿树成荫的街道和极其昂贵的住宅而闻名。

sentences.en: After getting her daughters organised, Marguerite dropped them off at Ascom School.
sentences.zh: 安顿好女儿们后，玛格丽特把她们送到了阿斯科姆学校。

sentences.en: She then made her way to an aerobics class, before doing some shopping at Bondi.
sentences.zh: 随后她去参加了一节健美操课，之后又去邦迪买了一些东西。

sentences.en: She then returned to her Wallara home sometime after midday.
sentences.zh: 中午过后，她回到了瓦拉拉的家中。

sentences.en: Later that afternoon, Marguerite's three daughters were waiting.
sentences.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，玛格丽特的三个女儿正在等她。

sentences.en: School had finished, and they were wondering where mum was.
sentences.zh: 学校已经放学了，她们在纳闷妈妈去哪儿了。

sentences.en: When Marguerite didn't show up to the school that afternoon, it was very unusual.
sentences.zh: 那天下午玛格丽特没有出现在学校，这非常反常。

sentences.en: Many of the other parents even commented, saying,
sentences.zh: 许多其他家长甚至评论说：

sentences.en: Don't worry, your mum is never late.
sentences.zh: “别担心，你们妈妈从不迟到。”

sentences.en: She'll be here soon.
sentences.zh: “她很快就会到的。”

sentences.en: But she never arrived.
sentences.zh: 但她始终没有出现。

sentences.en: The girls' next-door neighbour, Marcia Osborne, ended up giving them a lift home.
sentences.zh: 女孩们的邻居玛西娅·奥斯本最终开车送她们回了家。

sentences.en: Marcia telling them obviously something important had come up, and everything would be fine.
sentences.zh: 玛西娅告诉她们，显然是有什么重要的事情耽搁了，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: But the girls had a feeling something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 但女孩们总觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: When they got home, they saw Marguerite's car parked in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 当她们到家时，看到玛格丽特的车停在车道上。

sentences.en: They walked inside and called out for their mum, but got no reply.
sentences.zh: 她们走进屋里呼唤妈妈，却没有任何回应。

sentences.en: As they slowly made their way to the kitchen, they saw a pool of blood on the floor.
sentences.zh: 当她们慢慢走向厨房时，看到地板上有一滩血迹。

sentences.en: Blood on the bench.
sentences.zh: 长凳上有血。

sentences.en: Blood on the fridge.
sentences.zh: 冰箱上有血。

sentences.en: And that chairs had been knocked over.
sentences.zh: 椅子也被撞翻了。

sentences.en: Realising something was horribly wrong, Marcia grabbed the girls and said,
sentences.zh: 意识到情况极其不妙，玛西娅一把抓住女孩们说：

sentences.en: Let's get out of here.
sentences.zh: “我们离开这里。”

sentences.en: I'll ring the police.
sentences.zh: “我来报警。”

sentences.en: Police arrived soon after, and found Marguerite's body upstairs, laying in her walk-in wardrobe, connected to the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 警察很快赶到，在主卧相连的步入式衣帽间里发现了玛格丽特的遗体。

sentences.en: She had extensive head injuries, and one of Ian's neckties was wrapped around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她头部受了重伤，脖子上缠着伊恩的一条领带。

sentences.en: Another necktie had been used to gag her.
sentences.zh: 另一条领带被用来堵住她的嘴。

sentences.en: Detectives and specialist crime scene police were immediately called in, and a forensic examination was conducted.
sentences.zh: 侦探和专业犯罪现场警察立即被召集到场，并进行了法医鉴定。

sentences.en: No fingerprints were found, however, they did find a towel with blood stains on it.
sentences.zh: 现场没有发现指纹，但他们找到了一条沾有血迹的毛巾。

sentences.en: It was 1989, and DNA analysis had only started in New South Wales that year.
sentences.zh: 那是1989年，DNA分析技术在那一年才刚刚在新南威尔士州起步。

sentences.en: So there was no large database to compare the sample to, and the nature of the testing was very different to what exists today.
sentences.zh: 因此没有大型数据库可以比对样本，而且当时的检测性质与今天大不相同。

sentences.en: However, it was possible that it would come in useful in the future, to compare to a suspect, if one was ever identified.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果将来能确定嫌疑人，这些样本或许能派上用场进行比对。

sentences.en: It was clear from the forensic examination that the initial attack occurred downstairs, after which Marguerite was taken upstairs to the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 法医鉴定结果显示，最初的袭击发生在楼下，之后玛格丽特被带到了楼上的卧室。

sentences.en: She was struck to the head repeatedly with what the forensic pathologist believed was a small hammer, or similar tool.
sentences.zh: 法医病理学家认为，凶手用一把小锤子或类似的工具反复击打她的头部。

sentences.en: The injuries were extensive, causing a fractured skull and brain damage.
sentences.zh: 伤势非常严重，导致了颅骨骨折和脑损伤。

sentences.en: But the cause of death was strangulation.
sentences.zh: 但死因是窒息。

sentences.en: There was no sign of forced entry to the house.
sentences.zh: 房子没有被强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: Did Marguerite know her killer and let them in?
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特认识凶手并让他进屋了吗？

sentences.en: When they retraced Marguerite's steps, they found that she attended an aerobics class between 10.30am and 11.30am, at the nearby suburb of Bondi.
sentences.zh: 当警方重溯玛格丽特的行踪时，发现她在上午10点30分到11点30分之间参加了附近邦迪郊区的一节健美操课。

sentences.en: She was then seen shopping, also at Bondi, around midday.
sentences.zh: 中午左右，有人看到她在邦迪购物。

sentences.en: So that raised the possibility of another theory.
sentences.zh: 这引出了另一种可能性。

sentences.en: Marguerite was known to leave the door open while she was bringing in the shopping.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特有在搬运购物袋时敞开房门的习惯。

sentences.en: Was her killer waiting, and simply walked in behind her?
sentences.zh: 凶手是在等她，然后直接跟在她身后溜进去了吗？

sentences.en: Two witnesses were identified early on.
sentences.zh: 警方很早就锁定了两名目击者。

sentences.en: Both heard screams coming from the house.
sentences.zh: 两人都听到了从房子里传出的尖叫声。

sentences.en: One was a building surveyor, who looked in the direction of the house when he heard the screams, but when he didn't see anything, he got in his car and drove off.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是一名建筑测量师，他听到尖叫声后朝房子方向看去，但什么也没看见，于是就上车开车离开了。

sentences.en: The second was a woman who was walking past the house with her child.
sentences.zh: 第二个人是一位带着孩子路过房子的妇女。

sentences.en: She heard screams about 1.30pm, but decided not to report it, as she believed it to be just another domestic.
sentences.zh: 她在下午1点30分左右听到了尖叫声，但决定不报警，因为她以为那只是普通的家庭纠纷。

sentences.en: She kept walking, completely ignoring what she had heard.
sentences.zh: 她继续走着，完全无视了她所听到的声音。

sentences.en: When Ian asked the police if he could have Marguerite's jewellery back, there was no jewellery to give him.
sentences.zh: 当伊恩向警方询问能否拿回玛格丽特的珠宝时，警方表示没有珠宝可以交还给他。

sentences.en: She regularly wore a diamond ring and a watch, but the killer had taken it.
sentences.zh: 她平时常戴一枚钻戒和一块手表，但凶手把它们拿走了。

sentences.en: The ring alone was worth $20,000.
sentences.zh: 单是那枚戒指就价值2万美元。

sentences.en: It looked like a robbery had gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是一起抢劫案出了岔子。

sentences.en: Marguerite had no enemies, so it was the only thing that seemed to make sense.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特没有仇人，所以这似乎是唯一合理的解释。

sentences.en: It made even more sense when police learnt that extensive renovations had been carried out in the family home over the last few years.
sentences.zh: 当警方得知过去几年家里进行了大规模翻修时，这个推测显得更加合理了。

sentences.en: Ian wasn't able to offer much assistance with exactly who was hired, as Marguerite handled all of that while he was at work.
sentences.zh: 伊恩说不出具体雇了谁，因为他在上班，这些事都是玛格丽特负责的。

sentences.en: So did one of the tradesmen like what he saw inside the house, and decide to come back?
sentences.zh: 那么，是不是某个装修工看中了屋里的东西，决定回来行窃？

sentences.en: It seemed to fit, when you think about the forensic pathologist stating the weapon used looked to be a small hammer or similar tool.
sentences.zh: 考虑到法医病理学家称凶器看起来像是一把小锤子或类似工具，这似乎很吻合。

sentences.en: Police felt like they might be onto something.
sentences.zh: 警方觉得他们可能找到了线索。

sentences.en: There were no records kept of what tradesmen attended, so police got to work questioning as many of them as they could.
sentences.zh: 由于没有记录显示哪些工人来过，警方开始尽可能多地盘问他们。

sentences.en: Builders, carpenters, painters, tilers, plumbers.
sentences.zh: 建筑工、木匠、油漆工、瓦工、水管工。

sentences.en: It all amounted to nothing though.
sentences.zh: 但最终一无所获。

sentences.en: They never tracked down anyone who had completed work in the Edwards home.
sentences.zh: 他们始终没能追踪到任何在爱德华兹家完成过工作的人。

sentences.en: As good as the theory looked, it wasn't gaining any momentum.
sentences.zh: 尽管这个理论看起来很靠谱，但却没能取得任何进展。

sentences.en: Police even spent days searching every hardware store they could find, trying to find a hammer or similar tool that could have inflicted the injuries.
sentences.zh: 警方甚至花了几天时间搜查了他们能找到的每一家五金店，试图寻找可能造成这些伤口的锤子或类似工具。

sentences.en: It was hoped that if they could identify the tool, it would help narrow down the search for the tradesmen.
sentences.zh: 他们希望如果能确定凶器，将有助于缩小对装修工的排查范围。

sentences.en: But that also amounted to nothing.
sentences.zh: 但这同样一无所获。

sentences.en: They couldn't find anything that matched.
sentences.zh: 他们找不到任何匹配的工具。

sentences.en: Ian made an emotional appeal to the media, asking anybody with information to come forward.
sentences.zh: 伊恩向媒体发出感人呼吁，请求任何知情者挺身而出。

sentences.en: Photos of the stolen jewellery were also released to the media, in the hope that somebody would recognise them and they would turn up.
sentences.zh: 被盗珠宝的照片也被发布给媒体，希望有人能认出它们并提供线索。

sentences.en: They were expensive, unique pieces.
sentences.zh: 那些都是昂贵且独特的首饰。

sentences.en: But this didn't get the police anywhere either.
sentences.zh: 但这也没能给警方带来任何进展。

sentences.en: As much as they liked the robbery theory, they couldn't ignore the fact that the majority of murders are committed by somebody close to the victim.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们倾向于抢劫案的理论，但他们无法忽视一个事实：大多数谋杀案都是由受害者身边的人犯下的。

sentences.en: Everything suggested Ian and Marguerite were in a loving marriage, with no problems at all.
sentences.zh: 一切迹象都表明伊恩和玛格丽特婚姻美满，没有任何问题。

sentences.en: Ian was quoted as saying,
sentences.zh: 伊恩曾这样说道：

sentences.en: Ian went on to describe Marguerite as happy, graceful, always smiling, always laughing and never angry.
sentences.zh: 伊恩接着形容玛格丽特快乐、优雅，总是面带微笑，总是欢声笑语，从不生气。

sentences.en: Saying their marriage was perfect bliss.
sentences.zh: 称他们的婚姻是完美的幸福。

sentences.en: And Ian had an alibi.
sentences.zh: 而且伊恩有不在场证明。

sentences.en: He was at work the whole day.
sentences.zh: 他整天都在上班。

sentences.en: But it was when police started to look a bit closer, they realised that maybe Ian's alibi wasn't as solid as it initially seemed.
sentences.zh: 但当警方开始深入调查时，他们意识到伊恩的不在场证明似乎并不像最初看起来那么稳固。

sentences.en: Ian's orthodontic surgery was 2.2 kilometres away from the family home.
sentences.zh: 伊恩的正畸诊所距离他家只有2.2公里。

sentences.en: Roughly 1.3 miles.
sentences.zh: 大约1.3英里。

sentences.en: Through their investigation, they learnt that Ian was supposed to go home and have lunch with Marguerite the day she was killed.
sentences.zh: 通过调查，他们得知伊恩本应在玛格丽特遇害那天回家和她一起吃午饭。

sentences.en: But he says he got too busy and had to cancel.
sentences.zh: 但他声称自己太忙了，不得不取消。

sentences.en: Instead, he sent his nurse out to buy him a sandwich.
sentences.zh: 相反，他派护士出去帮他买三明治。

sentences.en: The nurse was out for 25 minutes, and Ian didn't have any patience during that time.
sentences.zh: 护士出去了25分钟，而伊恩在那段时间里显得非常急躁。

sentences.en: So there was a 25-minute window that Ian didn't have an alibi for.
sentences.zh: 所以伊恩有25分钟的时间窗口没有不在场证明。

sentences.en: Ian was a fit man, who was known to regularly go for a run during his lunch break.
sentences.zh: 伊恩身体健壮，众所周知他经常在午休时间跑步。

sentences.en: Police were able to confirm that his car never left the parking lot of his surgery.
sentences.zh: 警方确认他的车从未离开过诊所的停车场。

sentences.en: Could he have run home, killed Marguerite, and made it back to his surgery in time?
sentences.zh: 他有没有可能跑回家杀了玛格丽特，然后及时赶回诊所？

sentences.en: Two detectives completed the challenge.
sentences.zh: 两名侦探完成了这项测试。

sentences.en: Running from Ian's surgery to his house, and then back again.
sentences.zh: 从伊恩的诊所跑到他家，然后再跑回来。

sentences.en: Factoring in the time it would have taken to commit the murder, and the fact Ian was definitely back seeing a patient straight after lunch,
sentences.zh: 考虑到作案所需的时间，以及伊恩在午饭后确实立刻开始看诊，

sentences.en: showing no signs he had just been for a run, police were able to rule it out.
sentences.zh: 而且没有任何刚跑完步的迹象，警方排除了他的嫌疑。

sentences.en: They kept an open mind.
sentences.zh: 他们保持开放的态度。

sentences.en: Ian wasn't ruled out completely.
sentences.zh: 伊恩并没有被完全排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: But the idea he physically had anything to do with it was extremely doubtful.
sentences.zh: 但认为他亲手参与此事的可能性极低。

sentences.en: That pretty much left them back to square one.
sentences.zh: 这基本上让他们回到了原点。

sentences.en: The tradesman theory had gotten them nowhere, and Ian didn't look likely.
sentences.zh: 装修工的理论毫无进展，伊恩看起来也不像凶手。

sentences.en: That didn't stop the public's opinion, though.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止公众的猜测。

sentences.en: Ian felt the suspicious eyes on him everywhere he went.
sentences.zh: 伊恩走到哪里都能感觉到怀疑的目光。

sentences.en: His business partner of 17 years suddenly ended their relationship.
sentences.zh: 他合作了17年的商业伙伴突然结束了他们的合作关系。

sentences.en: And people in the area even held dinner parties to sit around and discuss theories about how Ian could have pulled it off.
sentences.zh: 当地人甚至举办晚宴，聚在一起讨论伊恩是如何实施犯罪的各种理论。

sentences.en: Police freely admitted the investigation had stalled, and it was going cold.
sentences.zh: 警方坦承调查已经陷入停滞，案件正在变成悬案。

sentences.en: It was nine months later, in May 1990, that a $50,000 reward was offered for any information that led to the case being solved.
sentences.zh: 九个月后的1990年5月，警方悬赏5万美元征集任何能破案的信息。

sentences.en: Not only that, the government took the step of offering a pardon to any person who may have assisted, so long as they weren't directly involved in the killing.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，政府还采取了措施，承诺对任何提供协助的人给予赦免，只要他们没有直接参与杀人。

sentences.en: Police did get plenty of calls and tips and names to check out, but none of it was useful.
sentences.zh: 警方确实接到了大量的电话、线索和嫌疑人名单，但都没有用。

sentences.en: The case continued to run cold, and it looked destined to remain on the unsolved shelf.
sentences.zh: 案件继续冷处理，看起来注定要被归入未解之谜的档案中。

sentences.en: But on the 23rd of August 1991, they got the break they were looking for.
sentences.zh: 但在1991年8月23日，他们得到了期待已久的突破。

sentences.en: 35-year-old Christopher Anthony Lorenzo was in Long Bay Jail in Sydney, waiting to be sentenced on several armed robbery charges.
sentences.zh: 35岁的克里斯托弗·安东尼·洛伦佐当时正被关在悉尼的长湾监狱，等待因多项武装抢劫罪被判刑。
zh_words: 克里斯托弗·安东尼·洛伦佐

sentences.en: Lorenzo was born in Cape Town, South Africa, on the 2nd of July 1956.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐于1956年7月2日出生在南非开普敦。

sentences.en: He had a history of drug use, break-ins, and armed robberies.
sentences.zh: 他有吸毒、入室盗窃和武装抢劫的前科。

sentences.en: Lorenzo had gotten the word out he had information that would be of interest to homicide detectives.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐放出话来，说他有凶杀案侦探会感兴趣的信息。

sentences.en: They paid him a visit, and became very interested in what he had to say, when he told them, he knew who killed the dentist's wife in Willara.
sentences.zh: 他们去探望了他，当他告诉他们他知道是谁杀了瓦拉拉那位牙医的妻子时，他们对此产生了浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: Prison inmates generally don't give information to police out of the kindness of their hearts.
sentences.zh: 监狱里的囚犯通常不会出于好心向警方提供信息。

sentences.en: There is always a motive.
sentences.zh: 总是有动机的。

sentences.en: And Lorenzo was no different.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐也不例外。

sentences.en: He wanted to be moved to a jail that was a bit easier to do time than Long Bay.
sentences.zh: 他想被转移到一所比长湾监狱日子好过一点的监狱。

sentences.en: And he wanted police to have a word to the judges, so he could get a reduced sentence for his armed robbery charges.
sentences.zh: 他还希望警方能跟法官打个招呼，以便减轻他的武装抢劫罪刑期。

sentences.en: He was facing a five-year sentence, but he didn't want to do that long.
sentences.zh: 他面临五年刑期，但他不想坐那么久的牢。

sentences.en: Lorenzo had made a handwritten statement for police, detailing everything he knew about Marguerite's murder.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐为警方写了一份手写声明，详细说明了他所知道的关于玛格丽特谋杀案的一切。

sentences.en: This was his story.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的故事。

sentences.en: The day Marguerite was murdered, Lorenzo was at a local pub having lunch and enjoying a few beers.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特遇害那天，洛伦佐正在当地一家酒吧吃午饭，喝着啤酒。

sentences.en: His friend David Anilzak approached him and wanted to borrow his car.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友大卫·阿尼扎克走过来，想借他的车。

sentences.en: It was actually Lorenzo's girlfriend's car, but he agreed.
sentences.zh: 那其实是他女朋友的车，但他同意了。

sentences.en: When Anilzak returned the car a few hours later, there was blood in it, and blood on Anilzak himself.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，当阿尼扎克还车时，车里有血，阿尼扎克身上也有血。

sentences.en: Lorenzo asked him, what the fuck happened?
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐问他，到底发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Anilzak told him he broke into a house, but it went wrong.
sentences.zh: 阿尼扎克告诉他，他闯进了一户人家，但出了岔子。

sentences.en: A woman saw him and started screaming, so he had to silence her.
sentences.zh: 一个女人看见了他并开始尖叫，所以他不得不让她闭嘴。

sentences.en: Anilzak pointed out a replica pistol in the boot and told Lorenzo to drown it.
sentences.zh: 阿尼扎克指了指后备箱里的一把仿制手枪，告诉洛伦佐把它处理掉。

sentences.en: But Lorenzo didn't get rid of the gun.
sentences.zh: 但洛伦佐并没有扔掉那把枪。

sentences.en: He decided to keep it for insurance.
sentences.zh: 他决定留着它作为筹码。

sentences.en: While he was cleaning up the blood in the car, he found an expensive-looking gold bracelet underneath one of the seats.
sentences.zh: 当他在清理车里的血迹时，在座位下发现了一个看起来很昂贵的金手镯。

sentences.en: He decided to keep that too, and he later gave it to his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 他也决定留下来，后来送给了他的女朋友。

sentences.en: Police believed Lorenzo's story had merit.
sentences.zh: 警方认为洛伦佐的故事有可信度。

sentences.en: Anilzak was well-known to them.
sentences.zh: 阿尼扎克是他们的熟面孔。

sentences.en: At the time of Marguerite's murder, he wasn't long out of prison after doing time for a manslaughter charge.
sentences.zh: 在玛格丽特遇害时，他因过失杀人罪刚出狱不久。

sentences.en: But they needed to do some background work to try and verify the story.
sentences.zh: 但他们需要做一些背景调查，试图核实这个故事。

sentences.en: Lorenzo said he could actually help them with that.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐说他其实可以帮他们解决那个问题。

sentences.en: He could give police the replica pistol that Anilzak told him to get rid of.
sentences.zh: 他可以把安尼扎克让他处理掉的那把仿制手枪交给警方。

sentences.en: In his words,
sentences.zh: 用他的话来说，

sentences.en: When Lorenzo was arrested for the armed robberies, police searched his house and took a number of items, including a replica pistol.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐因武装抢劫被捕时，警方搜查了他的住所，带走了一些物品，其中包括一把仿制手枪。

sentences.en: As Lorenzo's charges weren't finalised and he was still waiting to be sentenced, the replica pistol was still locked away in police evidence.
sentences.zh: 由于洛伦佐的指控尚未定案，他还在等待判刑，所以那把仿制手枪一直被锁在警方的证物室里。

sentences.en: The pistol was immediately sent to forensics to see if they could link it to the murder.
sentences.zh: 手枪被立即送往法医鉴定中心，看能否将其与谋杀案联系起来。

sentences.en: And they could.
sentences.zh: 结果确实可以。

sentences.en: Marguerite's head injuries were a match to the rear sight on the replica pistol.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特的头部伤口与仿制手枪的准星吻合。

sentences.en: So the weapon used wasn't a small hammer or similar tool, as previously thought.
sentences.zh: 所以凶器并不是之前认为的小锤子或类似工具。

sentences.en: Not only that, the pistol tested positive for blood.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，手枪上还检测出了血迹。

sentences.en: They also managed to track down Lorenzo's girlfriend, Josephine Tapani.
sentences.zh: 他们还设法找到了洛伦佐的女友约瑟芬·塔帕尼。

sentences.en: Not only did she confirm Lorenzo's story, but she still had the bracelet.
sentences.zh: 她不仅证实了洛伦佐的说法，而且她手里还有那个手链。

sentences.en: It was a bracelet that Marguerite had custom made.
sentences.zh: 那是玛格丽特定制的一条手链。

sentences.en: Nobody had realised it was missing until Lorenzo gave his story to police.
sentences.zh: 在洛伦佐向警方供述之前，没人意识到它不见了。

sentences.en: Josephine said it was Lorenzo who actually wore it around initially.
sentences.zh: 约瑟芬说，起初其实是洛伦佐戴着它。

sentences.en: But he said it was too tight for him, so he ended up giving it to her.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得戴着太紧，最后就送给了她。

sentences.en: His story was that somebody had given it to him at a takeaway shop in Surrey Hills, a suburb not too far away from Willara.
sentences.zh: 他的说法是，有人在萨里山的一家外卖店把它给了他，那是离威拉拉不远的一个郊区。

sentences.en: Lorenzo seemed genuine and authentic, and now there was some evidence to back up what he was saying.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐看起来很真诚，而且现在也有了一些证据来支持他的说法。

sentences.en: It looked like he was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 看起来他说的都是实话。

sentences.en: And the lure of a reduced sentence and a softer prison to do his time was enough for him to give up his friend.
sentences.zh: 而减刑和去条件更好的监狱服刑的诱惑，足以让他出卖自己的朋友。

sentences.en: David Anilzak became the prime suspect.
sentences.zh: 大卫·安尼扎克成了头号嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Lorenzo hadn't had any contact with Anilzak for a little while, so there was no suspicion when police put their plan into action.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐已经有一段时间没和安尼扎克联系了，所以当警方实施计划时，并没有引起怀疑。

sentences.en: They took Lorenzo out of jail and placed him into a motel room at Bondi, where they had installed both video and audio surveillance.
sentences.zh: 他们把洛伦佐从监狱里带出来，安置在邦迪的一家汽车旅馆房间里，并在那里安装了视频和音频监控。

sentences.en: Police were monitoring in the next room.
sentences.zh: 警方在隔壁房间进行监听。

sentences.en: The plan was simple.
sentences.zh: 计划很简单。

sentences.en: Lorenzo would lure his old buddy to the motel and get him talking about the murder of Marguerite.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐要把他的老伙计引诱到汽车旅馆，让他谈论玛格丽特的谋杀案。

sentences.en: As much as they believed Lorenzo was willing to help, they didn't completely trust him.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们相信洛伦佐愿意帮忙，但并没有完全信任他。

sentences.en: They couldn't handcuff him, that would give the game away.
sentences.zh: 他们不能给他戴上手铐，那样会打草惊蛇。

sentences.en: So what they did was put a plaster cast on his leg, making it impossible for him to run or to drive.
sentences.zh: 所以他们给他的腿打上了石膏，让他无法奔跑或开车。

sentences.en: Just as a bit of insurance, so he wasn't tempted to try and escape.
sentences.zh: 这只是为了保险起见，免得他动了逃跑的念头。

sentences.en: Anilzak arrived as planned, and Lorenzo got to work.
sentences.zh: 安尼扎克如约而至，洛伦佐开始行动了。

sentences.en: He was successful in getting Anilzak talking.
sentences.zh: 他成功让安尼扎克开了口。

sentences.en: They went at it for three hours.
sentences.zh: 他们聊了三个小时。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, not one second of the conversation had anything to do with the murder of Marguerite Edwards.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，这段对话中没有一秒钟与玛格丽特·爱德华兹的谋杀案有关。

sentences.en: Lorenzo didn't bring it up at all, and Anilzak wasn't volunteering anything.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐根本没提，安尼扎克也没有主动透露任何信息。

sentences.en: Lorenzo failed miserably.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐彻底失败了。

sentences.en: He acknowledged his failure and apologised, saying he was scared and he couldn't work out how to bring the murder up without making it obvious.
sentences.zh: 他承认了自己的失败并表示道歉，说他很害怕，不知道该怎么提起谋杀案才不会显得太刻意。

sentences.en: But the conversation didn't sit right with detectives.
sentences.zh: 但侦探们觉得这段对话有些不对劲。

sentences.en: It led them to become suspicious of what exactly his motive was.
sentences.zh: 这让他们开始怀疑他到底有什么动机。

sentences.en: They decided to go back and have a closer look at that handwritten statement he gave them.
sentences.zh: 他们决定回头重新仔细审视他给出的那份手写陈述。

sentences.en: There just so happened to be a world-renowned document profiler in Sydney at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时悉尼正好有一位世界知名的文件分析专家。

sentences.en: He was getting ready to fly back to the USA, but detectives just caught him in time at the airport.
sentences.zh: 他正准备飞回美国，但侦探们在机场及时拦住了他。

sentences.en: They handed him Lorenzo's statement, along with the background of the case.
sentences.zh: 他们把洛伦佐的陈述以及案件背景交给了他。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, detectives received a detailed 30-page report analysing Lorenzo's statement.
sentences.zh: 几周后，侦探们收到了一份长达30页的详细报告，分析了洛伦佐的陈述。

sentences.en: Every word and every phrase was looked at, as was the way Lorenzo's story changed from the first to the second person.
sentences.zh: 每一个字、每一个短语都被仔细研究过，洛伦佐的故事从第一人称到第三人称的转换方式也是如此。

sentences.en: The conclusion?
sentences.zh: 结论是什么？

sentences.en: If Christopher Lorenzo wasn't the murderer, he was at the very least present when the murder was committed.
sentences.zh: 如果克里斯托弗·洛伦佐不是凶手，他至少在谋杀发生时也在现场。

sentences.en: Police had a new number one suspect.
sentences.zh: 警方有了新的头号嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Lorenzo had a unique blood type, found in just 3% of the population.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐的血型很罕见，仅占人口的3%。

sentences.en: That matched the blood type found on the towel at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 这与犯罪现场毛巾上发现的血型相符。

sentences.en: Given that Lorenzo was cooperating with police on a murder investigation, he had been moved to a special part of the jail reserved for police informants.
sentences.zh: 鉴于洛伦佐在谋杀调查中与警方合作，他被转移到了监狱中专门留给警方线人的区域。

sentences.en: The rats, the snitches, as they are commonly known.
sentences.zh: 也就是俗称的“老鼠”或“告密者”。

sentences.en: He became a little too friendly with his cellmate, whose identity is protected.
sentences.zh: 他和狱友变得过于亲近，其身份受到保护。

sentences.en: But he was given the nickname Mr. Smith.
sentences.zh: 但他被起了个绰号叫“史密斯先生”。

sentences.en: Lorenzo couldn't help but brag how he had put one over the police.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐忍不住吹嘘自己是如何把警察耍得团团转的。

sentences.en: He obviously forgot what part of the jail he was in, because Mr. Smith notified the police, and they quickly arranged for him to wear a wire.
sentences.zh: 他显然忘了自己身处监狱的哪个区域，因为史密斯先生通知了警方，他们很快安排他戴上了窃听器。

sentences.en: On the 19th of June 1992, Smith got him talking again.
sentences.zh: 1992年6月19日，史密斯再次让他开了口。

sentences.en: Lorenzo claimed there were actually two other men present during the murder, and they were all off their faces on heroin.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐声称谋杀时其实还有另外两个人在场，而且他们当时都吸了海洛因，神志不清。

sentences.en: Lorenzo said,
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐说，

sentences.en: The woman came home, and John pointed the gun at her, and she started screaming.
sentences.zh: 那个女人回家了，约翰用枪指着她，她开始尖叫。

sentences.en: He grabbed her and started hitting her in the head with the butt of the pistol until she shut up.
sentences.zh: 他抓住她，用手枪柄猛击她的头部，直到她闭嘴。

sentences.en: See, what sparked him off was her screaming, because he told her to shut up.
sentences.zh: 你看，激怒他的是她的尖叫，因为他叫她闭嘴。

sentences.en: He pointed the gun at her.
sentences.zh: 他用枪指着她。

sentences.en: She screamed, and she kept screaming.
sentences.zh: 她尖叫，而且一直尖叫个不停。

sentences.en: The more he hit her, the more she screamed.
sentences.zh: 他打得越狠，她叫得越响。

sentences.en: Smith
sentences.zh: 史密斯

sentences.en: So he would have hit her in a frenzy.
sentences.zh: 所以他是疯狂地殴打她。

sentences.en: Yeah, because she was screaming.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为她在尖叫。

sentences.en: Smith
sentences.zh: 史密斯

sentences.en: So she was screaming, and he's bashed her in the head.
sentences.zh: 所以她在尖叫，他就猛击她的头部。

sentences.en: Lorenzo
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐

sentences.en: And she wouldn't stop screaming.
sentences.zh: 而且她一直尖叫个不停。

sentences.en: Smith
sentences.zh: 史密斯

sentences.en: Why did he hit her?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要打她？

sentences.en: He could have put his hand over her mouth.
sentences.zh: 他本可以捂住她的嘴。

sentences.en: Lorenzo
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐

sentences.en: We had just had a shot of smack before going there, and John just panicked and started hitting her in the head.
sentences.zh: 我们去那儿之前刚打了一针海洛因，约翰当时慌了，就开始猛击她的头部。

sentences.en: Then she was taken upstairs to her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 然后她被带到了楼上的卧室。

sentences.en: She came to and started screaming again.
sentences.zh: 她醒过来又开始尖叫。

sentences.en: John hit her in the head a few more times.
sentences.zh: 约翰又往她头上打了好几下。

sentences.en: She kept screaming, so this other guy grabbed a tie and strangled her with it, and left her lying in the wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 她还在尖叫，所以另一个人抓起一条领带勒死了她，把她扔在衣柜里。

sentences.en: Smith
sentences.zh: 史密斯

sentences.en: Why did he strangle her?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要勒死她？

sentences.en: Lorenzo
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐

sentences.en: Because she could identify the other guy.
sentences.zh: 因为她能认出那个人。

sentences.en: This next passage will give you an idea of who the other guy was.
sentences.zh: 接下来的这段话会让你知道那个人是谁。

sentences.en: Smith
sentences.zh: 史密斯

sentences.en: Is Dr. Edwards well off?
sentences.zh: 爱德华兹医生很有钱吗？

sentences.en: Lorenzo
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐

sentences.en: When I did the tiling at their house, I used their phone so I could check out the house.
sentences.zh: 我在他们家铺瓷砖的时候，用过他们的电话，这样我就可以观察一下房子。

sentences.en: They were loaded.
sentences.zh: 他们非常有钱。

sentences.en: The tradesman theory was right all along.
sentences.zh: “装修工理论”一直都是对的。

sentences.en: Christopher Lorenzo had been to the Edwards home during their renovations.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗·洛伦佐在爱德华兹家装修期间去过那里。

sentences.en: He had completed tiling work there over a number of days in September 1998.
sentences.zh: 他在1998年9月用了几天时间完成了那里的瓷砖工作。

sentences.en: About one year before the murder.
sentences.zh: 大约在谋杀案发生前一年。

sentences.en: Police were unaware of that before Lorenzo's taped conversation.
sentences.zh: 在洛伦佐的录音对话之前，警方并不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Lorenzo was trying to say there were other people involved.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐试图说还有其他人参与。

sentences.en: So it was like a confession, but he couldn't come out and directly say it was just him.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是一种供述，但他无法直接说出就是他自己干的。

sentences.en: So he described her to someone else who attacked her.
sentences.zh: 于是他把她描述成被别人袭击了。

sentences.en: The guy who was scared Marguerite could identify him was of course Lorenzo.
sentences.zh: 那个害怕被玛格丽特认出来的人，当然就是洛伦佐。

sentences.en: He was talking about himself.
sentences.zh: 他其实是在说他自己。

sentences.en: Lorenzo then bragged how he stole Marguerite's watch, ring and bracelet.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐随后吹嘘自己是如何偷走玛格丽特的手表、戒指和手链的。

sentences.en: Smith asked him if he had much trouble getting the ring off.
sentences.zh: 史密斯问他摘下戒指时有没有遇到什么麻烦。

sentences.en: Lorenzo said
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐说

sentences.en: Nah, none, none.
sentences.zh: 没，一点都没有。

sentences.en: But I mean she had blood all over her hands, over her head.
sentences.zh: 但我是说，她的手上、头上全是血。

sentences.en: Why do you think I couldn't sleep for six months?
sentences.zh: 你以为我为什么六个月都睡不着觉？

sentences.en: Smith
sentences.zh: 史密斯

sentences.en: Did you have to turn her over or anything like that to get the rings?
sentences.zh: 你为了拿戒指，是不是还得把她翻过来什么的？

sentences.en: Lorenzo
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐

sentences.en: Nah, nah, nah, nah.
sentences.zh: 没，没，没，没。

sentences.en: She was just laying there with...
sentences.zh: 她就躺在那儿，带着……

sentences.en: Her hands were tied behind her back, so it was easy.
sentences.zh: 她的手被绑在背后，所以很容易。

sentences.en: So she was laying face down.
sentences.zh: 所以她是脸朝下躺着的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was easy.
sentences.zh: 是的，很容易。

sentences.en: It wasn't hard.
sentences.zh: 一点都不难。

sentences.en: Then Lorenzo started talking about the bracelet.
sentences.zh: 然后洛伦佐开始谈论那个手链。

sentences.en: They can never charge anybody with that.
sentences.zh: 他们永远没法因为那个起诉任何人。

sentences.en: It wasn't reported as missing from the scene of the crime.
sentences.zh: 案发现场并没有报告它丢失。

sentences.en: I could have stolen at any time I was at that house.
sentences.zh: 我在那房子里的任何时候都可以偷走它。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: When I was tiling it.
sentences.zh: 我铺瓷砖的时候。

sentences.en: That's why there's been nothing ever on this bracelet.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这条手链从来没被查到过。

sentences.en: Smith then asked
sentences.zh: 史密斯接着问

sentences.en: Did anybody who went into the house cut themselves?
sentences.zh: 进屋的人有没有人割伤自己？

sentences.en: Leave any blood behind?
sentences.zh: 留下什么血迹了吗？

sentences.en: Anything that might have been mixed with her blood?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么东西可能混进了她的血里？

sentences.en: You said you cut your hand.
sentences.zh: 你说你割伤了手。

sentences.en: Lorenzo
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Smith, could you have dropped any blood inside the house?
sentences.zh: 史密斯，你有没有可能在屋里滴过血？

sentences.en: Lorenzo
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐

sentences.en: Only thing in the place was on the towel.
sentences.zh: 屋里唯一的东西就在那条毛巾上。

sentences.en: Where was the towel used?
sentences.zh: 那条毛巾是用来干嘛的？

sentences.en: To wipe down the fucking handles and shit.
sentences.zh: 用来擦那些该死的把手之类的东西。

sentences.en: Lorenzo was so confident because he really believed in his alibi.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐之所以如此自信，是因为他真的相信自己的不在场证明。

sentences.en: That he was at the pub having lunch at the time of the murder.
sentences.zh: 那就是谋杀发生时他在酒吧吃午饭。

sentences.en: And he never left.
sentences.zh: 而且他从未离开过。

sentences.en: He didn't think police would ever be able to crack it.
sentences.zh: 他认为警方永远无法破解这个谎言。

sentences.en: My alibi is sweet.
sentences.zh: 我的不在场证明天衣无缝。

sentences.en: Three years ago, no one's going to even remember me in the pub.
sentences.zh: 三年前的事了，没人会记得我在酒吧里的样子。

sentences.en: But no one's going to remember me of being in that pub.
sentences.zh: 也没人会记得我当时在不在那个酒吧。

sentences.en: So how long were you going from the pub?
sentences.zh: 那你离开酒吧多久了？

sentences.en: If it was anything without my marriage back.
sentences.zh: 如果这和我婚姻无关的话。

sentences.en: Just in case you had trouble picking that up.
sentences.zh: 以防你没听明白。

sentences.en: My alibi is sweet.
sentences.zh: 我的不在场证明天衣无缝。

sentences.en: It was three years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是三年前的事了。

sentences.en: No one's going to even remember me in the pub.
sentences.zh: 没人会记得我在酒吧里的样子。

sentences.en: But no one's going to remember me not being in that pub.
sentences.zh: 也没人会记得我当时不在那个酒吧。

sentences.en: So how long were you gone from the pub?
sentences.zh: 那你离开酒吧多久了？

sentences.en: An hour.
sentences.zh: 一小时。

sentences.en: Something like that.
sentences.zh: 差不多吧。

sentences.en: Three quarters of an hour.
sentences.zh: 四十五分钟。

sentences.en: Coppers can't prove anything.
sentences.zh: 警察什么也证明不了。

sentences.en: Lorenzo saw how well off the Edwards looked and decided to go back and steal from them.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐看到爱德华兹一家生活优渥，便决定回去偷窃。

sentences.en: Breaking in using a copied key he had from when he was tiling.
sentences.zh: 他利用之前做瓷砖工时私配的钥匙潜入屋内。

sentences.en: That's why there was no sign of forced entry.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么现场没有强行闯入的痕迹。

sentences.en: But Marguerite came home while he was there.
sentences.zh: 但玛格丽特在他行窃时回了家。

sentences.en: Instead of running away, he decided to kill her.
sentences.zh: 他没有逃跑，而是决定杀人灭口。

sentences.en: Lorenzo's attempt to pin a murder he had committed onto somebody else, in order to have his jail time reduced, backfired in a big way.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐为了减刑，试图将自己犯下的谋杀罪嫁祸给他人，结果却弄巧成拙。

sentences.en: On the 7th of July 1992, Lorenzo was taken from Long Bay Jail to a nearby police station where he was interviewed and charged with the murder of Marguerite Edwards.
sentences.zh: 1992年7月7日，洛伦佐被从长湾监狱带到附近的警察局，接受审讯并被指控谋杀玛格丽特·爱德华兹。

sentences.en: He pleaded not guilty, and his trial was held in the Supreme Court and commenced in September 1993.
sentences.zh: 他拒不认罪，案件于1993年9月在最高法院开庭审理。

sentences.en: Lorenzo wasn't done with his old mate, David Anilzak, either.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐也没放过他的老友大卫·阿尼尔扎克。

sentences.en: Ignoring the conversation that had been recorded, he went back to his original story that he gave police, that Anilzak burrowed his car and he was just at the pub the whole time.
sentences.zh: 他无视那段被录下的对话，坚持最初对警察的说辞，声称阿尼尔扎克借了他的车，而他当时一直待在酒吧里。

sentences.en: The recorded conversation being explained away as just bragging to his cellmate, trying to make himself look good.
sentences.zh: 他辩称那段录音只是在狱友面前吹牛，想让自己显得厉害些。

sentences.en: This time he added an explanation for his blood being at the scene, and that was that Anilzak made him go to the house after the murder to wipe it down for fingerprints,
sentences.zh: 这一次，他为现场留有他的血迹编造了解释，称是阿尼尔扎克在谋杀后强迫他去屋里擦拭指纹，

sentences.en: and it was while wiping the place down, he cut himself.
sentences.zh: 而在擦拭现场时，他不小心割伤了自己。

sentences.en: The trial lasted four weeks.
sentences.zh: 审判持续了四周。

sentences.en: It took the jury just over three hours to reach their verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪审团仅用了三个多小时就达成了裁决。

sentences.en: Guilty.
sentences.zh: 有罪。

sentences.en: Ian Edwards had this to say after the verdict came through.
sentences.zh: 伊恩·爱德华兹在判决下达后发表了如下感言。

sentences.en: We spent four weeks in there listening to how somebody bashed and strangled her to death.
sentences.zh: 我们在那儿坐了四周，听着别人讲述她是如何被殴打并勒死的。

sentences.en: We're glad that it's finished technically for us, and that somebody has been convicted of the crime.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴这件事对我们来说在法律上已经结束了，而且有人为这起罪行受到了惩罚。

sentences.en: We don't hate Lorenzo in any way.
sentences.zh: 我们并不恨洛伦佐。

sentences.en: He did what he did, and that was his mistake.
sentences.zh: 他做了他做的事，那是他自己的错。

sentences.en: And he'll now have the rest of his life, I think, to think about it in jail.
sentences.zh: 我想，他余生都将在监狱里反思这件事。

sentences.en: He could have at least had the courage to maybe admit what he did, and I think it would have been a lot easier on everybody concerned, including himself.
sentences.zh: 他本可以至少拿出勇气承认自己所做的一切，我想这对所有相关人员，包括他自己，都会轻松得多。

sentences.en: What he was trying to do was tell the world what he did, only he didn't have the courage to say he did it.
sentences.zh: 他试图向全世界坦白自己的罪行，只是他没有勇气承认那是他干的。

sentences.en: He used somebody else as the medium of relieving his own conscience.
sentences.zh: 他把别人当作了减轻自己良心负担的工具。

sentences.en: The judge said to Lorenzo it was a cowardly and brutal attack.
sentences.zh: 法官对洛伦佐说，这是一起懦弱而残暴的袭击。

sentences.en: A murder in her own home, in broad daylight, of a woman going about her own business, who had done you no harm.
sentences.zh: 在光天化日之下，在受害者自己的家中，谋杀了一位正在过着平静生活、从未伤害过你的女性。

sentences.en: Knowing that Marguerite would be able to identify him as the Tyler from the year before, he decided to kill her.
sentences.zh: 因为知道玛格丽特能认出他就是一年前那个贴瓷砖的工人，他决定杀人灭口。

sentences.en: Lorenzo was sentenced on the 26th of November 1993.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐于1993年11月26日被判刑。

sentences.en: He received a sentence of 22 years and 6 months, with a non-parole period of 17 years.
sentences.zh: 他被判处22年零6个月监禁，其中17年不得假释。

sentences.en: But Lorenzo had since been sentenced on the armed robbery charges, and they didn't expire until October 1996.
sentences.zh: 但洛伦佐此前还因武装抢劫罪被判刑，该刑期直到1996年10月才结束。

sentences.en: So his sentence for the murder didn't start until then.
sentences.zh: 所以他的谋杀罪刑期要到那时才开始计算。

sentences.en: Meaning he would be eligible to be released in 2013.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他要到2013年才有资格获释。

sentences.en: Luckily, instead of keeping his mouth shut and doing his five-year sentence for armed robbery,
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，洛伦佐没有闭嘴服完他那五年的武装抢劫刑期，

sentences.en: Lorenzo decided to try and pin a murder on a friend to get out early.
sentences.zh: 而是决定试图嫁祸朋友以求早日出狱。

sentences.en: In doing so, he implicated himself and the case was able to be solved.
sentences.zh: 结果他反而牵连了自己，案件也因此得以侦破。

sentences.en: Instead of five, he would now be in jail for at least 22 years.
sentences.zh: 他现在不仅没能只坐五年牢，反而要入狱至少22年。

sentences.en: On the 30th of November 2010,
Lorenzo made a visit to the prison doctor, complaining that he had been feeling unwell for a while.
sentences.zh: 洛伦佐去看了监狱医生，抱怨说自己身体不适已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: Tests revealed he was suffering from advanced stages of leukemia.
sentences.zh: 检查结果显示他患有晚期白血病。

sentences.en: He was transferred to Prince of Wales Hospital.
sentences.zh: 他被转送至威尔士亲王医院。

sentences.en: He died two months later on the 9th of January 2011, aged 54.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，即2011年1月9日，他去世了，终年54岁。

sentences.en: Two years and nine months before he was eligible for parole.
sentences.zh: 距离他获得假释资格还有两年零九个月。

sentences.en: He died three months later on the 9th of January 2011.
sentences.zh: 三个月后，即2011年1月9日，他去世了。

sentences.en: He died three months later on the 9th of January 2011.
sentences.zh: 三个月后，即2011年1月9日，他去世了。
